name: geostat
expr: [m_s, v_s] = geostat(0.3); [m_v, v_v] = geostat([0.1 0.5 0.9]); [m_1, v_1] = geostat(1); m_0 = geostat(0); m_neg = geostat(-0.1); m_over = geostat(1.5);
comment: Sig: [m, v] = geostat(p). Geometric (number-of-failures form): m = (1-p)/p, v = (1-p)/p². p=1 → m=v=0. Vectorised. p<=0 or p>1 => NaN.
